recipes.title: Chicken Chicharrones (Blended Chicken Chips)

items.i: chicken seasoning or spices of choice

steps: Blend the chicken breast, seasoning and baking soda into a smooth paste.
Spread onto a parchment-lined tray and press it paper-thin — put a second sheet of parchment or plastic wrap on top and flatten evenly. If it's too thick you'll get a burger, not a chip.
Bake at about 400°F until deep golden and crisp all the way through, roughly 20–25 minutes (flip or peel off the parchment partway if needed).
Break into chips and serve with a good dipping sauce.
recipes.notes: Reaction video with no amounts or oven settings shown, so quantities, the bake time and temperature, and carbs/fat are estimates; 506 cal and 89 g protein for the whole batch are as stated in the title.
